shared_elements: single main figure occupying the upper-central field
low-relief animal/creature form (elaborate anthropomorph in A; quadruped in B)
elongated sinuous element descending below the main figure (in A a body/ornament, in B a snake-like form)
justification: Both are upright monuments carrying a single relief subject in the upper-central field with something elongated running down below it, which is about as generic as monumental relief gets. The depicted content differs fundamentally: A shows an elaborately costumed standing human with headdress, ornaments and rectangular sign blocks in dense, highly detailed relief, while B shows a bare pillar with one sparse, schematic quadruped in profile and a sinuous form beneath, with no figures, signs or costume.
